format: iNES 1.0; offsets are absolute file offsets including the 16-byte iNES header

track.name: intro/opening cue
track.prg_bank: 0x0F / disassembly bank label 8F (CPU address $B7AD; the original machine code writes the selected bank through MMC3 register $8001)

driver.note: This is original 6502 driver code, not a standalone audio waveform. It requires the game's CPU/RAM/APU and MMC3 bank context to execute faithfully. The local disassembly renders the operand symbol as $5115, but the verified 6502 instruction bytes are 8C 01 80: STY $8001.

dpcm_sample_blob.byte_verified_lead: Exact match to DPCM.bin in the local disassembly repository; the target ROM itself is the extraction source.
dpcm_sample_blob.mapping_note: The F9/FA/FB driver handlers program DMC $4012/$4013. Their DMC-address-to-ROM-bank mapping on this mapper has not yet been traced, so this source blob is not assigned to those commands as a proven playback mapping.

nsf_banking_analysis.source_prg_layout: 32 x 8 KiB banks; iNES header excluded from bank arithmetic
nsf_banking_analysis.limitation: The game driver expects MMC3 $8001 bank writes and original RAM/channel initialization. Standard NSF 4 KiB pages are not a drop-in replacement; no init/play wrapper or bank-write translation has been implemented.

extraction.method: Copied exact byte ranges from the supplied ROM after validating its full-file SHA-256; no emulator capture, WAV, or screenshot is used.
extraction.runtime_note: These reference extracts are not runtime dependencies. A playback implementation still needs a byte-verified driver/sequence renderer or a pre-render generated from the original driver.
